register.title: Registration
register.what-is-cooprog:
CooProg is a free collaborative platform for building tours, accessible to all professionals who present or program works in the performing arts and/or contemporary music sectors.

CooProg is led by Onda (French Office for Contemporary Performing Arts Circulation) and Zone Franche - the World Music Network.
register.information:
Welcome to CooProg.

This space is intended for diffusion structures and artistic teams working in performing arts and music.

Please select your account type below to begin your registration.
register.information-diffusion-structure: CooProg welcomes the registrations of performing arts and current music programmers in Europe. The opening of the platform to other geographical spaces will be considered according to its success. Therefore, if you are programmers outside Europe and interested in the project, we kindly ask you to contact CooProg: contact@cooprog.eu.

We appreciate your patience and understanding, and we look forward to welcoming you to the CooProg community shortly.
waiting-approval.message:
Thank you for your interest in **CooProg** and for your registration request.

CooProg is a collaborative platform dedicated to **building shared tours** between programmers.

To ensure that CooProg remains a space for trusted exchange, your registration is **subject to validation by a moderator**.

This step simply aims to verify that requests come from professionals working in programming at a diffusion structure at the indicated address.

The verification period is **two working days**. You will be informed by email of the outcome of your request.

Once your profile is validated, you will be able to use CooProg to **plan coordinated and more environmentally friendly tours**.

For any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at: **contact@cooprog.eu**
